```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import os
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Central bank current policy target benchmarks
CURRENT_RATES = {
    'FED': {'name': 'Federal Reserve (Fed)', 'rate': 5.25, 'file': 'data/fomc_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_fed.html'},
    'ECB': {'name': 'European Central Bank (ECB)', 'rate': 3.50, 'file': 'data/ecb_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_ecb.html'},
    'BOE': {'name': 'Bank of England (BoE)', 'rate': 3.75, 'file': 'data/boe_implied_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_boe.html'},
    'BOJ': {'name': 'Bank of Japan (BoJ)', 'rate': 1.25, 'file': 'data/boj_implied_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_boj.html'},
    'BOC': {'name': 'Bank of Canada (BoC)', 'rate': 2.25, 'file': 'data/boc_implied_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_boc.html'},
    'RBA': {'name': 'Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA)', 'rate': 4.60, 'file': 'data/rba_implied_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_rba.html'},
    'SNB': {'name': 'Swiss National Bank (SNB)', 'rate': 0.00, 'file': 'data/snb_implied_curve.csv', 'link': 'rates_snb.html'}
}

summary_rows = []

for key, meta in CURRENT_RATES.items():
    if os.path.exists(meta['file']):
        df = pd.read_csv(meta['file'])
        if not df.empty:
            next_mtg = df.iloc[0]
            next_date = next_mtg.get('meeting_date', 'N/A')
            next_implied = next_mtg.get('implied_rate', 0.0)
            cur_rate = meta['rate']
            change_bps = round((next_implied - cur_rate) * 100, 1)
            
            summary_rows.append({
                'Central Bank': f"<a href='{meta['link']}'><b>{meta['name']}</b></a>",
                'Current Policy Rate': f"{cur_rate:.2f}%",
                'Next Meeting Date': str(next_date),
                'Next Implied Rate': f"{next_implied:.2f}%",
                'Expected Move (bps)': f"{change_bps:+} bps"
            })

df_summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
```
